API ReferenceZscaler Cloud & Branch Connector APIAuthenticationGet Authenticated Session
Get Authenticated Session
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/ztw/api/v1/auth

Checks if there is an authenticated session.

Responses
​
200

Successful Operation. When an authenticated session exists, the response contains authType information. If authType is not present, the authenticated session has expired or does not exist.

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
authType
string

Login type.

Possible values: [ADMIN_LOGIN, SUPPORT_ACCESS_PARTIAL, SUPPORT_ACCESS_FULL, TEMPLATE_ORG_BY_ZSUPPORT, TEMPLATE_ORG_BY_PARTNER, PARTNER_ACCESS, INTEGRATION_PARTNER_ACCESS, DEFAULT_LOGIN, ADMIN_SAML_SSO_LOGIN, SUPPORT_ACCESS_READ_ONLY, MOBILE_APP_TOKEN]

obfuscateApiKey
boolean

Indicates whether API key is obfuscated.

loginName
string

Internal use only.

partnerCss
string

Internal use only.

Possible values: [DEFAULT, COLOR_MAGENTA]

locale
string

Internal use only.

passwordExpiryTime
int64

Password expiry time.

passwordExpiryDays
int32

Password expiry days.

source
string

Internal use only.

readOnly
boolean

Internal use only.

ssoZccAdminAccess
boolean

Internal use only.

ssoZccAdminUrl
string

Internal use only.
